purpose_context: Issue #23 asked spec-kitty-events to publish canonical MissionDossier payload builders, a validator API, and golden valid/invalid fixtures for all four dossier events. Missions 008 and 009 already shipped the typed payload models, the validate_event() API, and historical-envelope documentation (released as v2.4.0). The one remaining gap owned by this repo is fixture coverage: MissionDossierArtifactMissing and MissionDossierSnapshotComputed have valid fixtures but no invalid fixtures, unlike ArtifactIndexed and ParityDriftDetected. This mission closes that gap so the repo can assert full acceptance-criteria coverage for its portion of #23. The companion spec-kitty-repo mirror deletion is tracked in spec-kitty issue #1058 (open, blocked on this issue, not yet started as of 2026-08-20).
purpose_tldr: Close the spec-kitty-events side of GitHub issue #23 by adding the missing invalid conformance fixtures for two dossier event payloads.
